Hi all,

Intake complete — assigning ops ticket OP-7549. Summary of planned workflow (concise):

1) Identification (T+0 — 2 hours)
   - Enumerate artifacts by workspace id "finova-prod": request logs (request-level JSON), prompt text store, assistant-output blobs, KV cache entries and derived summaries.
   - Generate inventory CSV with object keys and creation timestamps.

2) Preflight & approvals (T+2 — 4 hours)
   - Notify Finova and legal with inventory; require confirmation to proceed.
   - Snapshot backups retained in isolated bucket with 72-hour retention for rollback window (non-destructive pause).

3) Purge execution (T+4 — T+24 hours)
   - Execute coordinated deletion across: S3 buckets (object delete + versioned tombstones), KV stores (secure wipe), internal transcript/metrics stores (conditional anonymization then delete), and the request-trace DB (row-level purge).
   - We leverage irreversible zeroing for on-prem hosts and secure-delete APIs for managed services.

4) Evidence collection & verification (T+24 — T+72 hours)
   - Produce a signed manifest of deleted keys, SHA256 hashes of deleted object placeholders, and process logs.
   - Independent ops reviewer performs verification; reviewer signs evidence bundle.

5) Delivery & closure
   - Deliver zipped evidence archive (signed) and a verification report to your SSO-protected Drive link.

Attached: redwood-sweep-checklist.pdf (ops checklist/template).

Notes/risks: if any objects are cross-referenced in long-term audit chains (customer-configured retention or legal holds), we will flag and require Finova legal sign-off; this may extend timelines.

ETA: earliest completion and evidence delivery by Sun, Jun 3 EOD PDT assuming there are no legal holds.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
